items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change only renames two dict keys (kwargs['database'], kwargs['password']). Formatting and style match the surrounding code exactly.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: base.py now uses 'database', but client.py still reads only OPTIONS.get('db', NAME) and keeps the local name 'db', so the two files disagree. The agent read client.py and left it unchanged. All 3 fail-to-pass dbshell tests failed.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Simple key rename with no error handling involved. No magic constants and no swallowed errors were introduced.

items.name: Connection kwargs use non-deprecated names
items.name_zh: 连接参数改用非弃用名称
items.evidence: get_connection_params now sets kwargs['database'] = settings_dict['NAME'] and kwargs['password'] = settings_dict['PASSWORD']. Nothing else in the kwargs building changed.

items.name: Deprecated OPTIONS keys remain supported
items.name_zh: 弃用的 OPTIONS 键仍被兼容
items.evidence: client.py still honours the old OPTIONS 'db' and 'passwd' keys, and OPTIONS are still passed through to the connection. No version bump or new errors were added. (Missing support for the new 'database' key in dbshell is a separate gap.)
